notes: «ره» and «(ع)» are blessings and are not part of any surface
«أخيه علي بن مهزيار» is one link: the name alone (rule 7)
«سأل رجل أبا عبد الله» — the asker is a man in Haroun's account and is only in the scene (rule 5); Haroun («وأنا عنده») is the link in place
the Imam, asked and answering, is named in the words after the chain: last link, kind imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
«أبي القاسم» is a bare kunya, written as it stands
